title: Zedekiah, the Rebellion and the Fall of Jerusalem
description: King Zedekiah refuses to humble himself before the prophet Jeremiah and rebels against Nebuchadnezzar. The people and priests act treacherously, mocking God's messenger until the Lord's wrath falls upon them. The Chaldeans capture Jerusalem, burn down the temple, tear down the walls, and lead the people into exile in Babylon.
